baseline_incident_edges.relationship: Distinguishes Vovelle’s quantitative history of religious practice from a qualitative history of different Christian models.
baseline_incident_edges.evidence_note: Own1975 pp56–60 explicitly calls this a methodological dialogue, says the chosen dossier is unassailable within its horizons and warns hasty readers against extrapolating religion’s complete disappearance. The comparison is undirected and not a claim Vovelle himself predicted Christianity’s death. Both approaches have distinct objects and can coexist; no manufactured personal quarrel.
